author: rsi_demo
title: G40 · 拒绝
body: I changed only matMul: a plain left matrix is now materialized once into a dense Float64Array and passed to the unchanged proven typed 2×2/eight-way kernel, while typed inputs retain their existing path. This directly targets the large train/holdout representation disparity and removes repeated plain-array representation overhead from the cubic kernel without changing FMA safety, arithmetic order, tails, output type, or argument immutability; a 1.65× matrix factor would project roughly 62.0× overall, above the 61.159× acceptance threshold.
